'''Morita-no-Kami''' ({{nihongo|守達神|もりたのかみ}}) is a deity in the local tradition of {{nihongo|Suwa Faith|諏訪信仰}}, centered in {{nihongo|Nagano Prefecture|長野県}}. The deity is worshiped primarily as a pioneer god.

[[File:Suwa-taisha Kamisha Maemiya - Wakamiko-sha (若御子社).jpg|thumb|250px|Young Deity Shrine (Wakamiko-sha) at Suwa Taisha]]

== Overview ==
At {{ill|Morita Shrine (Nagano)|ja|守田神社 (七二会)}} in Nagano City, the primary shrine dedicated to Morita-no-Kami, the deity is considered the fifth son of {{ill|Takeminakata|es|Takeminakata|hu|Takeminakata|id|Takeminakata|ja|タケミナカタ|mni|ꯇꯀꯦꯃꯤꯅꯀꯇ|pl|Takeminakata|zh|建御名方神|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}} and is celebrated as the ancestral god of development in the region. Morita-no-Kami is often equated with the deity {{nihongo|Udachi-no-Kami|宇達神}}, mentioned in the {{nihongo|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|日本三代実録}} in 863 CE, and worshiped at {{ill|Udachi Shrine (Nagano)|ja|宇達神社}} in Nagano City. According to tradition, Udachi-no-Kami is sometimes identified as a form of {{nihongo|Deidatsurajin|泥土立神}}. Additionally, a genealogy compiled by the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏}} in the early Meiji period equates Morita-no-Kami with the second-generation family head {{nihongo|Moritaku-no-Kami|守宅神|1=Moritaku-no-Kami}}.

In 863 CE, "Adachi-no-Kami" was promoted to {{nihongo|Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade|従五位上|1=Junior Fifth Rank|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}}, and in 865 CE, "Udachi-no-Kami" was elevated to {{nihongo|Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade|従四位下|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade|1=Junior Fourth Rank}}. These honors likely refer to Morita-no-Kami.

== Genealogy ==
[[File:Moriya Family Tree - 守矢氏系図.png|170px|thumb|Genealogy of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏}}]]

Morita-no-Kami is the son of {{ill|Takeminakata|es|Takeminakata|hu|Takeminakata|id|Takeminakata|ja|タケミナカタ|mni|ꯇꯀꯦꯃꯤꯅꯀꯇ|pl|Takeminakata|zh|建御名方神|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}} and {{ill|Yasakatome|ja|八坂刀売神|simple|Yasakatome|zh|八坂刀賣神|qid=Q9150392|lt=Yasakatome}}. His children include {{ill|Koshinao-no-Kami|ja|高志奈男神}} and {{ill|Mitutama-hime-no-Mikoto|ja|美都多麻比売命}}.

Mitutama-hime-no-Mikoto bore {{ill|Yakushi-no-Kami|ja|八櫛神}} with {{ill|Katakurabe no Mikoto|ja|片倉辺命|lt=Katakurabe-no-Mikoto}}. Yakushi-no-Kami is considered the fifth head of the Moriya clan.
